correctness.rationale: On each interval between consecutive J_mu zeros, the normalized Turan quotient Phi has divergent endpoints and satisfies x Phi_x/2=1-(1+y)Phi and at stationary Phi_xx=2 Phi^2>0, giving a unique analytic minimizer for each fixed n. At mu=0 the minimizer is j_(1,n); Bessel order derivative and Wronskian yield cubic beta expansion and negative beta_mu_mu. Independent scipy minimizations at mu=.01,.03,.06 agree with cubic to O(mu^4). Uniform differentiable large-order Olver/Airy turning-point expansions give beta=c_n mu^(-2/3)+O(mu^(-4/3)) and beta_mu_mu=(10c_n/9)mu^(-8/3)+O(mu^(-10/3)); the Airy minimum is unique from F prime and F double-prime. The derivative error depends on the stated complex-order uniform expansions, not on differentiating a raw pointwise limit.

evidence: DLMF provides uniform large-order Bessel/Airy turning-point machinery; it does not state the optimized nodal beta curvature coefficients.
